dataset: synthetic GJR-GARCH(1,1,1) with standardised Student-t innovations
synthetic_data_notice: SYNTHETIC DATA. These are simulated observations, not market history.
date_index: Synthetic Monday-Friday business-day index from pandas.bdate_range. It is NOT an exchange trading calendar and contains no holidays.

columns.return_pct: simulated log return in percentage points (1.0 = 1%)
columns.true_vol_pct: true conditional volatility sigma_t of return_pct, percentage points; known at t-1 in the data-generating process
columns.stress_flag: 1 inside a predefined stress regime, else 0

process.returns: r_t = mu + eps_t, eps_t = sigma_t * z_t
process.innovations: z_t = T_t * sqrt((nu-2)/nu), T_t ~ Student-t(nu) via numpy Generator.standard_t
process.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(seed); all burn-in + retained shocks drawn in one call
process.initialisation: sigma_0^2 at the first burn-in observation equals the baseline unconditional variance omega/(1 - alpha - gamma/2 - beta); burn-in observations are discarded
process.stress_definition: for retained zero-based indices within each regime (inclusive), omega_t = omega * stress_omega_multiplier; burn-in is never stressed
process.stress_note: Stress regimes are fixed before any forecasting and intentionally depart from a single constant-parameter GJR process.
